title: Lightly Lacquered Roman Pumpkin Torta di Zucca alla Romana
description: A fresh and chewy Italian dessert featuring roasted pumpkin, a pescatarian-friendly take on the classic Roman vitello-tonnato. This date-night dish is perfect for fall and winter evenings.
instructions: Sift together the flour and sugar in a medium bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the ricotta cheese, eggs, and nutmeg.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, flour mixture, and ricotta mixture.
Mix until smooth and well combined.
Pour the batter into a greased and floured torta pan.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
While the torta is baking, prepare the lacquer glaze by whisking together the heavy cream and lacquer glaze in a small saucepan.
Remove the torta from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before glazing.
Drizzle the lacquer glaze over the torta and serve warm or at room temperature.
